question: On February 20, 1947, who announced that the power would be transferred to the Indians by June 1948?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Clement Attlee.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

 
• **Clement Attlee, the Prime Minister of the United Kingdom,** **announced on 20 February 1947** **that:**

 
 
• **The British Government would grant full self-government to British India by 30 June 1948 at the latest.**
 
 
 
• He also announced the** appointment of Lord Mountbatten as Viceroy in place of Lord Wavell.​**​
